relationships.scope: Candidate link: the 2019 circular supersedes all previous circulars on the norms and specifications of laptops, desktops, printers, UPS, virus scanners and MS Office without naming them. It reaches only those items in the 2016 norms; other equipment (servers, networking) is not addressed.

evidence.quote: This circular supersedes all previous circulars dealing with the norms and specifications of Laptop, Desktop, Printer, UPS, Virus Scanner and MS Office

relationships.scope: Candidate link: the 2014 revised desktop specification falls within the class of earlier desktop specifications the 2019 circular supersedes; it is not named.
The 2018 guidelines require the 2008 obsolescence policy to be followed when replacing old desktops; the 2008 policy is not changed.
The 2019 circular again requires the 2008 obsolescence policy to be strictly followed when replacing old desktops, PCs and printers.

limitations: This collection covers Information Services specifications and norms for EPFO computer hardware and the obsolescence policy. Staff laptop entitlement and reimbursement are in the Employee benefits collection; delegation of purchase powers is in the Delegation collection.

The 25 October 2021 specifications of laptops, desktops and tablet PCs, which the 11 December 2025 circular says it supersedes, are not in the issuer's circulars table and are not in this collection. The 2019 laptop and desktop specifications appear to have been replaced by that 2021 circular, but no direct link is asserted here.

The 2019 circular supersedes all previous circulars on the norms and specifications of laptops, desktops, printers, UPS, virus scanners and MS Office without naming them; those links stay unverified and reach only the named items. Norms for servers, networking and other equipment have no stated replacement.
The 9 May 2018 laptop purchase guidelines are issued in supersession of an earlier communication that is not in this collection.
Warranty, AMC and rate-contract circulars, budget notices and individual purchase approvals are not covered.
The 2025 specifications are in force with immediate effect until further orders (stated); no other commencement dates are stated in the checked circulars.

PDFs were read from the issuer mirror on 4 November 2026 because the public site returned 404 for these paths; recorded SHA-256 values apply to those files. Scanned pages are OCR. Issue dates were checked against the document headers.
